name: Career Crox – Calling Assistant
tagline: Transform your recruitment workflow with automated dialing, real-time CRM synchronization, and intelligent performance tracking.
description:
Transform your recruitment workflow with automated dialing, real-time CRM synchronization, and intelligent performance tracking. The ultimate mobile companion for recruitment professionals using Career Crox CRM.

Workflow Redefined

🚀 Smart Calling Automation

Automated dialing queue with configurable 10-second preparation countdowns between calls. Dual mode control lets recruiters pause or resume from mobile or remotely via desktop CRM.

🔄 Instant CRM Synchronization

Synchronize candidate call list with a single tap. All call outcomes, timestamps, incoming/missed history, and notes automatically flow back to CRM database.

📊 Live Metrics & AHT Tracking

Monitor real-time stats including total Dialed, Connected, and Not Connected calls. Automatically calculates Average Handling Time (AHT) to maintain quality benchmarks.

📁 Resumes & Audio Recordings

Upload candidate resumes (PDF, Word, Images) directly from phone to CRM. Seamlessly attach call audio recordings to candidate profiles for interview audits.

💬 WhatsApp & Quick Feedback

Initiate WhatsApp conversations instantly without saving phone numbers to your device. Post-call presets (Interested, Busy, Call Back) allow rapid note logging.

🔒 Secure 6-Digit Device Pairing

Pair your Android phone securely with Career Crox CRM using a 6-digit code. Features session validation, remote logout, and enterprise-grade authentication.

🚀 Quick Setup Guide

Step 1: Secure Device Pairing

Open the app and enter the 6-digit pairing code generated by your Career Crox CRM web dashboard.

Step 2: Sync Calling Queue

Once paired, tap Sync to pull assigned candidate list and priority tasks from the CRM.

Step 3: Start Automation

Hit Start Calling. The app will navigate through your queue, initiating calls with smart cooldowns in between.

Step 4: Document & Close

Upload resumes, link call recordings, and update candidate statuses directly from the post-call interface.
